title: Drunken Potatoes
preamble:
Ingredients:-
1
tbsp olive oil
150g/5½oz
potatoes, cut into thick slices
2
fresh sprigs thyme, leaves picked
2
cloves garlic, chopped
150ml/5fl
oz white wine
salt
and freshly ground black pepper

1
tbsp olive oil
150g/5½oz
potatoes, cut into thick slices
2
fresh sprigs thyme, leaves picked
2
cloves garlic, chopped
150ml/5fl
oz white wine
salt
and freshly ground black pepper

Method:-
Heat the oil in a sauté pan.
Add the potatoes and cook for three minutes or until browned slightly on all sides over a medium heat.
Add the thyme and garlic to the potatoes and cook for one minute.
Increase the heat of the pan and add the wine.
Bring to a simmer, cover with a lid and cook for 12 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked.
